histogram_ranknet: At each training time, 64/128 adaptive margin cells with separate positive/negative centroids approximate all same-time pair gradients. Exact at common margins or noncolliding cells; no sampled pair matrix. Gradients are scaled by N/(2*total_pair_count).
metric: All screening, primary CV and bootstrap use exact float32 TS-AUC; only the training loss gradient is approximated.
NDCG_policy: Exploratory only. Fixed lambdarank truncation 64 and binary label gains [0,1]. No NDCG result is a selection authority.

candidates.hypothesis: Same-time pairwise ranking loss may improve TS-AUC ordering beyond individually weighted binary loss.
candidates.change: Only supervised objective changes; query-sorted binary control isolates the mandatory row grouping of built-in ranking.
candidates.expected_effect: Better within-time ordering without any validation-target statistics entering the objective
candidates.risks: Histogram or pair-sampling approximation; ranking losses remain surrogates; NDCG positions and query normalization do not exactly match pair-count-weighted AUC.
